As of 9 May 2022, investigators identified a Foundry CEO Mike Colyer impersonator account on Twitter. The account’s handle appears the same as the authentic account, but actually utilizes a capital ‘i’ in place of the ‘L’ in ‘Colyer.’ The impersonator account’s first Tweet was posted on 19 January 2022. Since then, it has exclusively posted re-tweets of the authentic Mike Colyer account.

Investigators engaged the impersonator and learned the scammer directs potential targets to the Block Mining website, right. The site was created on 18 March 2022 and registered with NameCheap, a popular domain registrar. It advertises ‘cloud mining’ services giving potential investors and “the opportunity to multiply potential income.” The site lists the mobile number right, registered in San Antonio, Texas with Onvoy Spectrum, LLC (a telecoms company frequently used for spam calls).

Investigators identified three cryptocurrency wallet addresses (Bitcoin, Bitcoin Cash, and Ethereum) associated with this scam, right, and reported them to cryptocurrency exchanges as being linked to fraud.
